summary: Build newsroom-ready data stories, charts, and visual packages in 5 days. Learn OpenRefine, Excel, Datawrapper, and Illustrator.
lede: Data journalism and visual storytelling help reporters and editors turn datasets into clear, evidence-led stories. For newsroom professionals who produce or review this work, the course develops practical skills in finding and cleaning data, reading patterns and uncertainty, choosing charts, and checking visual evidence through an editorial workflow before publication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you already produce or edit evidence-led stories and need sharper control over data sourcing, visual logic, and editorial accuracy in a fast-moving newsroom.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with newsroom reporting, basic spreadsheet use, and online source evaluation. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable working with tabular data, reading charts, and drafting publication copy. Experience with Excel or Google Sheets is helpful, and familiarity with OpenRefine, Datawrapper, or Flourish will make the applied exercises easier to complete.
